title: Mazloom Hussain(english)
body:
hussain - 2
Mazloom hussain
o son of muhammad
o son of Ali
O the love of fatema -2
Ya gareebe karbala  - 8
1. saviour of humanity, axis of equality - 2
source of spirituality, symbol of purity
o hussain you are the will of god - 2
strike on brutality
<<DIVIDER>>
2. O the love of Almighty, victim of brutality - 2 To revive morality, sacrificed your family
By the side of flowing river- 2
O hussain you died thirsty
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Your blood spilled in oppression, Your kids faced aggression - 2
O hussain you stood for love, o hussain you stood for peace
O hussain you spread justice, O the ship of salvation
